about.title: Hi, I'm Shahid Afridi 👋
about.description: I'm a passionate Web Developer based in Bengaluru, India. I specialize in crafting dynamic, user-friendly web applications with clean and responsive designs. My expertise lies in modern web technologies like React.js, TypeScript, and AWS services, ensuring robust and scalable solutions. I thrive in collaborative environments, consistently delivering user-focused and high-performance applications. Outside of work, I enjoy exploring new tech trends and optimizing workflows to bring innovative ideas to life.

experience.title: Software Engineer II
description: Developed and maintained backend microservices for banking and transfer domains using Java and Spring Boot, focusing on scalable and secure transaction processing systems.
Worked on real-time transfer systems enabling instant fund movement between bank accounts with emphasis on transaction reliability, low latency, and secure processing.
Contributed to subledger transaction modules, including allowance and chores management workflows between parent and child accounts, handling balance updates and transaction tracking.
Implemented internal fund transfer functionalities supporting seamless transfers between customer-owned accounts within the banking ecosystem.
Developed external account management features allowing customers to link and manage external bank accounts for transfers and related financial operations.
Integrated and worked with databases including PostgreSQL and Amazon Aurora using tools such as DBeaver for query optimization, debugging, and data validation.
Utilized tools and platforms including Maven, Swagger, Splunk, Liquibase, and PactFlow for API development, monitoring, database versioning, and contract testing.
Worked with version control and collaboration platforms including Git, Bitbucket, Jira, and Confluence for agile delivery and documentation management.

Leveraged AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot along with Jira MCP and Confluence MCP integrations to improve development productivity, requirement analysis, and documentation workflows.
Participated in organizational Innovation Week hackathon initiatives, collaborating on innovative solution development and rapid prototyping within banking technology use cases.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
description: Developed innovative customer-facing and internal web applications for a prestigious German luxury automobile client, utilizing React.js, TypeScript, Vite, and JavaScript to deliver exceptional digital experiences across multiple high-impact projects.
Engineered highly interactive and visually stunning user interfaces with React.js and TypeScript, driving engagement and ensuring seamless user experiences.
Leveraged Vite to streamline development and build processes, significantly boosting overall project efficiency and reducing time-to-market.
Employed React Testing Library, Jest, and SonarQube to guarantee robust functionality and maintainable code, leading to reduced errors and improved code quality.
Utilized the i18n framework for localizing web applications into multiple languages, catering to a diverse global audience.
Facilitated smooth communication between front-end and back-end services by integrating APIs using Swagger and Postman.
Designed scalable serverless solutions using AWS Lambda and CloudFront, enhancing performance and reducing infrastructure costs.

experience.title: Associate Developer
description: Engineered sophisticated web applications leveraging React, Redux, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and JSON to deliver seamless and dynamic user experiences.
Utilized Git, Fiddler, Jenkins, VS Code, Swagger, IBM RTC, and Cloud Controller to enhance project workflows and support strong DOM manipulation practices.
Gained extensive experience working with REST APIs and JSON for efficient and reliable data exchange.
Crafted responsive designs using Bootstrap and Material UI, ensuring cross-browser compatibility and optimal user experiences.
Designed and developed a secure web application for a banking and financial institution, facilitating financial transactions and integrating SWIFT, MPF, Fedwire, and IBT payment methods.
Collaborated on a dynamic telecommunication web application that enabled retail store employees to manage customer requests, plan upgrades, and device purchases.
Used SonarQube, Elastic Kibana, and Jira to drive project management, quality assurance, and data analysis, improving efficiency by 25%.
Worked with cross-functional teams across China, USA, and Australia to enhance global communication and project delivery.
